text:
laura: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to @mike, @dena, and @ops-team for the midnight rollback + hotfix last night. Saved the demo. Passing the applause baton 🥁 :tada:

mike: Team effort all the way. Special shout to @sam for the config patch that actually unblocked the queue. Couldn’t have done it without the triage call. :raised_hands:

sam: ahah, small patch, big consequences. I’ll accept cookies or iced coffee as payment 🍪☕️

dena: Also huge props to @customer-success for fielding the demo panic and keeping the client calm. Seriously clutch. :heart:

kudos-bot: Awarded 10 kudos to @mike and 5 kudos to @sam — see /kudos for details. :medal_military:

sam: quick question — celebratory brunch tomorrow? pizza or bagels? :pizza: :bagel:

laura: tally so far (emoji votes): 6 :pizza:, 2 :bagel: — pizza looks like the winner :pizza: :sparkles:

tori: I can bring pastries/fruit if someone handles the coffee run. happy to coordinate.

mike: I’ll take coffee duty. Also deployed a tiny follow-up that should stop the state leak; tailing logs now.

ops-bot: Deploy completed at 2026-03-20T06:12Z — no errors detected.

infra-bot: FYI I restarted the stuck node at 05:47Z, rebalanced jobs, and bumped the retry threshold. All green.

laura: You all are amazing — thanks for jumping in. Officially archived this applause orchestra; see you for pizza tomorrow! :tada: :clap:
